wording.rule: Two products, two prices. Chamber = security (half). TRU8 = compression. TRU8 Year $1,900 = both products for one year. TRU8 demos free. Suite is a meter.

glossary.Chamber: security product — 3-hour black box, then Day $12.50 · Month $87.50 · Year $950. No TRU8 production. Half the matching TRU8 tier.
glossary.TRU8: compression product — public demos free with credit. Day $24.99 and Month $175 are compression only. Year $1,900 is both products (Chamber + TRU8) for one year.
glossary.TruChamber: legacy name. Public face is Chamber (security) + TRU8 (compression). Old truchamber-* SKUs alias to tru8-*.
glossary.seat: a purchased Chamber or TRU8 access path (day / month / year) for a named human or agent. Not the Suite meter.
glossary.Suite: metered encode/decode jobs — 100 GB free then ~5¢/GB; not Chamber; not TRU8; not a seat
glossary.Access: entitlement claim after payment — not a codec dump
glossary.SiOS: Synthetic Intelligent OS. The house the lab runs on. Not a seat. Not a third product.
glossary.phi-rest: Serve layer. Called bytes open once, RAM, X-Phi-Rest. Not Chamber.
glossary.TruGame: game engine (building). Inquire corey@ subject TruGame.
